name_zh: 卡塔尔·塔米姆：天然气半岛与世界杯调解小国外交
name_en: Qatar Tamim: Natural Gas Peninsula & World Cup Mediation Small State Diplomacy
description_zh: 塔米姆·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼 (1980-) 卡塔尔埃米尔 (2013-)，天然气财富支撑半岛电视台/主权财富基金/2022世界杯，调解阿富汗/也门/黎巴嫩冲突，小国通过软硬实力组合实现战略自主。
description_en: Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani (1980-) Qatar Emir (2013-), natural gas wealth funds Al Jazeera/sovereign wealth fund/2022 World Cup, mediates Afghanistan/Yemen/Lebanon conflicts, small state achieves strategic autonomy through soft-hard power combination.
reason_zh: 塔米姆代表超级富裕小国如何通过媒体/金融/体育三重软实力配合能源硬实力超越地理局限，展示了调解者角色如何为小国赢得大国尊重与战略空间，其世界杯举办重塑国家品牌。
reason_en: Tamim represents how super-rich small state transcends geographic limits through media/finance/sports triple soft power combined with energy hard power, demonstrating how mediator role wins great power respect and strategic space for small state, his World Cup hosting reshaped national brand.
steps_zh: 研究塔米姆早年英国军校与2013年父王禅位
分析天然气垄断支撑主权财富基金全球投资
探讨半岛电视台阿拉伯媒体话语权重塑
评估2022世界杯举办与阿富汗塔利班/也门/黎巴嫩调解
总结天然气半岛世界杯调解小国外交对微型国家战略自主的范式创新
steps_en: Study Tamim early British military academy and 2013 father abdication
Analyze natural gas monopoly supporting SWF global investment
Explore Al Jazeera Arab media discourse reshaping
Evaluate 2022 World Cup hosting and Afghanistan Taliban/Yemen/Lebanon mediation
Summarize natural gas peninsula World Cup mediation small state diplomacy paradigm innovation for micro-state strategic autonomy
expected_zh: 掌握能源财富如何转化为媒体金融体育三重软实力杠杆，理解小国调解者角色如何突破大国垄断地区事务权力，评估卡塔尔模式对文莱新加坡等小国的示范与差异。
expected_en: Master how energy wealth converts to media finance sports triple soft power levers, understand how small state mediator role breaks great power monopoly on regional affairs, evaluate Qatar model demonstration and divergence for Brunei Singapore small states.
case_zh: 2013 埃米尔；天然气垄断；2022 世界杯；持续调解。天然气半岛世界杯调解范式永存。
case_en: 2013 Emir; natural gas monopoly; 2022 World Cup; ongoing mediation. Natural gas peninsula World Cup mediation paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Gulf Rentier Mediator / Soft Power State
cross_cultural_impact: Natural gas wealth; Al Jazeera; World Cup; mediation; small state autonomy
